description:
About the company
 Our client is a financial technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own software projects from first idea through to production in a small, high-autonomy engineering team. Build and extend data, research and execution systems, and work closely with researchers on modeling. The role spans a broad range of problems and rewards curiosity and independent thinking.
 What you'll do
 - Take projects from concept through implementation and into production, owning them end to end.
 - Build and extend existing systems, or create new ones, for data pipelines, signal generation and research infrastructure.
 - Develop automated execution systems and internal tooling that shorten the path from idea to live experiment.
 - Partner directly with quantitative and AI researchers on new modeling approaches.
 - Contribute across several technical areas, including low-latency infrastructure, security and machine learning.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Degree in computer science, math, statistics or physics.
 - Experience building and shipping a project end to end as the owner, from first idea to production.
 - Hands-on background in financial or trading software, data platforms, or a fintech or crypto environment.
 - Exceptional software engineering skills in Python or C++.
 - A solid grasp of statistics and the ability to draw sound conclusions from messy, imperfect data.
 - Experience with AI-assisted development workflows.
 - Ability to work on-site in the office five days a week.
 - Roughly 1 to 5 years of experience, with curiosity about financial markets and comfort with ambiguity.
 Bonus points
 - Prior internship at a quantitative trading firm.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 200,000 to 300,000 per year
 - Ownership stake in the company
 - Performance bonus
 Location and work model
 - Palo Alto, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
